svg.title: Physical board and audited digital board at matched full-board fit
svg.desc: Side-by-side comparison of a crop around the physical board and the 1440 by 900 audited-board reset-fit capture. Both panels use the same 640 by 400 frame. The source photograph is scaled uniformly and cropped to the board area; the digital capture preserves its 16-to-10 viewport aspect ratio. The physical photograph still has perspective, so this supports human review but does not record acceptance.
svg.text: Source: full-game-setup.jpg · crop preserves the photo's aspect ratio; perspective remains.
Current 1440×900 fit capture · no HUD · all 336 cells in frame.
Review cell count, alternating rows, silhouette, coast/sea cut-outs, feature placement, labels, stack fit, and visible interactions.
